attempts.summary: Deployed a Python-based inventory web app (JSON API on /, /api/inventory, /health) on node2 and node3 as OpenRC services listening on port 8080, and configured nginx on node1 as a round-robin HTTP load balancer on port 80 across both backends. Verified traffic distribution, then completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all three nodes with boot-identity proof and full post-restart recovery (services auto-started, LB restored) at each step.
